source_label: Lax pair; representation of integrable systems
canonical_statement: For a finite-dimensional complex matrix path L on a real time domain, a Lax evolution dL/dt = [P,L] together with sufficient hypotheses producing conjugation evolution preserves the spectrum of L across the domain.
domain_and_universes: provisionally n : Type u with DecidableEq n and Fintype n; L P : Real -> Matrix n n Complex; timeDomain : Set Real; result in Prop

hypotheses: L satisfies the matrix Lax equation on timeDomain
regularity sufficient for the derivative/evolution formulation
a conjugating evolution is available or is constructed from separately frozen sufficient hypotheses
conclusion: for all t0 and t in timeDomain, spectrum Complex (L t) = spectrum Complex (L t0)
boundary_cases: an empty or singleton timeDomain makes the relational conclusion vacuous/trivial
dimension zero is provisionally permitted by the finite type formulation
constant paths and P = 0 are legitimate special cases
excluded_scope: a theorem that every notion of integrable system admits a Lax representation
